description: Poll processing for a short bounded wait (default 12s, max 15s). Targets: track_playback (playable ready/incomplete), track_output (requires output_index), track_settled (files_completed_at), cover (requires cloudflare_image_id plus collection_id or track_id). Returns pending with the same ids when the budget expires — processing continues; call again to resume. Does not cancel workers. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_wait_for_processing
